description: Speak through the open coach: the words, queued for the coach and spoken in the voice the person chose on the coach once the coach view holds the coach; and optional cues (GoldAvatar's show_frame, action, head, set_caption, speaking, mouth_shapes, blink, idle, auto_revert) at sentence or beat boundaries. Words sent while the coach is still speaking wait their turn, so a short acknowledgment can go first and the answer after it. The coach view shows the words beside the coach as it speaks them: do not repeat them in the chat; while the view is showing the coach, your chat reply is one short line naming what you looked up. Use the coach_id open_coach returned. The answer says what was queued; a queued line is not evidence the person heard it.

arguments.description: The cue's own arguments, as GoldAvatar's tool of that name takes them

reply_to.description: Optional: the message this answers, when it came through the coach

text.description: What the coach says, as you would say it
